messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "doses based on weight in children and teenagers"
set: ["doses based on weight in children and teenagers", "based on weight in children and teenagers", "2000 mg/day in divided doses", "10 mg/day for adolescents and higher-weight children", "own doses", "depends on age, weight, diet, and other factors", "450 mg/day in up to 4 divided doses", "150 mg orally per day in divided doses", "10 mg orally per day in divided doses", "5 mg orally per day in divided doses", "all six doses", "5 to 60 mg per day in divided doses", "10 mg or 20 mg per day for children and adolescents aged 8 and older", "5 mg orally per day in divided doses for narcolepsy", "20 mg to 60 mg per day for adolescents and higher-weight children", "four 15 mg/0.6 mL doses"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
